criticism: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the mintedAmount is large, the balanceOf[target] += mintedAmount; totalSupply += mintedAmount; can cause a overflow, and the minted tokens will be lost forever.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the _value is large, the balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value; can cause a overflow, and the overflowed value will be added to the target's balance.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the _value is large, the balanceOf[_from] -= _value; can cause a overflow, and the overflowed value will be added to the target's balance.

The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the amount is large, the balanceOf[msg.sender] += amount; can cause a overflow, and the overflowed value will be added to the target's balance.
The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the amount is large, the balanceOf[this] += amount; can cause a overflow, and the overflowed value will be added to the target's balance.
